mapper.sql: SELECT COALESCE(material_id, material_code) AS uuid, MAX(material_id) AS materialId, MAX(material_code) AS materialCode, MAX(material_name) AS materialName, MAX(model) AS model, MAX(brand) AS brand, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) AS inboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'OUT' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END), 2) AS outboundQuantity, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'IN' THEN quantity ELSE -quantity END), 2) AS balanceQuantity FROM goods_transaction_dynamic_info gtdi GROUP BY COALESCE(material_id, material_code)
